messages:
carmen: Bringing up andalus9b (Mistral-ish arch) on dedicated; initial fp16 looks fine but int4 quant runs show weird tokenization / combining-mark split. Summaries hallucinate around names with diacritics. attaching short repro and logs. anyone seen a zeroshim / tokenizer-normalize interaction like this? :thinking:
ev an: I remember a similar smell on gemma-lite where nfkc vs nfkd produced different token boundaries. Could be normalization + byte->token mapping causing kv-cache/headwise mismatch later. :eyes:
jia: Can you paste the small repro? I can run the tokenizer tests locally. Quick check: run this snippet and see token counts and offsets:
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file('andalus9b-tokenizer.json')
s = 'José́ and cómpañía'  # has combining acute on e and o
enc = tok.encode(s)
print(enc.tokens)
print(enc.offsets)
```
It'll show if combining marks became separate tokens.

carmen: repro log attached inline: tokens show `e`, `́` split (separate token id 50213). When we quantize to int4 using the default per-channel config the model emits a sentinel token at generation boundary and then repeats a hallucinated phrase. Quick eval numbers: fp16 rougeL=0.412, int4 rougeL=0.349 (large tail on diacritic lines).

triage-bot: autotest run: `and9b/andals9b/int4/short-summaries` finished (12 runs) - 8/12 triggered token-split pattern. Full logs: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/1799987654/andals-int4/trace.log

hugo: two separate hypotheses: 1) tokenizer normalization mismatch (encoder conversion pipeline used different NFKC/NFKD at export), 2) rotary index/kvcache offset combined with token-id zeros inserted when converter saw unexpected sentinel ids. The latter can happen if the vocab conversion created an extra placeholder id (zeroshim) for unmappped bytes. Check converter mapping table for unmapped->0.
ev an: To add, when we've seen sentinel-like repeats it was because the token id was 0 in embedding matrix (all zeros) after conversion, which makes attention attend weirdly post-quant. Can you run `inspect_vocab_map.py --model andalus9b --map` and grep for unmapped->0?

carmen: ran inspect, snippet: `orig_id: 50213 -> mapped_id: 0  # COMBINING_ACUTE` — aha. converter fell back to zero. Attached output.

jia: ok that's consistent. Two quick mitigations: 1) remap unmapped tokens to a high-id reserved slot (not zero) before quant/sq8 export; 2) enable tokenizer normalization to NFKC before export and re-run conversion so combining marks compose. I can try remapping locally and run the int4 export flow. Which quant toolchain did you use?

carmen: used qlora-style int4 pipeline via optimize/quantify v0.9 with `--profile per-channel` and default converter script (export_vocab.py).

hugo: if you go remap-route, watch out for rotary headwise scaling differences. When you reassign ids the head->pos mapping must be unchanged; otherwise kvcache offsets shift. After remap, run a simple kvcache-consistency test: feed same prompt twice with cache warm and without, compare logits for next token at step 12. We have a small script `kvcache_check.py` in infra repo.

carmen: jia — can you try remap -> int4 export -> run kvcache_check and summary eval? If it fixes, we'll add converter guard to avoid mapping to 0. If not, we'll dig into rotary scaling.

jia: on it. ETA ~30m. starting with remap to reserved id 65000 and re-export. Will post short logs.

(30m later)
jia: quick update: remap->65000 + re-export + int4 quant cut rougeL drop from 0.063 to 0.012 vs fp16 on our short-summaries set. kvcache_check shows matching logits at step 12 within 1e-3 (was 0.12 previously). So remap fixed the immediate regression. :tada:

ev an: great. That points squarely to zeroshim fallback. I'll open a small patch on export_vocab.py to error on unmapped->0 and optionally emit an automatic remap flag.

hugo: follow-ups: 1) add a unit test in conversion CI that runs the combining-mark sample string through tokenizer -> mapped ids -> embedding lookup to ensure no zeros in embedding indices; 2) add a sanity check in Optimize that warns when quantized embedding row 0 is all zeros.

carmen: filing an eval ticket to re-run larger summarization sweep and canary on dedicated. Thanks all. I'll paste the remap diff and command I used:
```bash
# remap step (local helper)
python tools/remap_unmapped_tokens.py --vocab andalus9b-vocab.json --reserved-id 65000 --out andalus9b-vocab-remap.json
# export+quant
python export_v2.py --vocab andalus9b-vocab-remap.json --model andalus9b.safetensors --out andalus9b-int4 --quant int4 --profile per-channel
# kvcache check
python infra/kvcache_check.py --model andalus9b-int4 --prompt-file tests/diacritic-snippets.txt
```

ec: tagging docs: we should document this zeroshim/unmapped fallback in model onboarding checklist. @doc-team FYI. :memo:
